pass_rule.pass: the one-sided 95% bound lies inside the margin
pass_rule.fail: the point estimate lies beyond the margin
pass_rule.inconclusive: the point estimate is inside the margin but the bound crosses it
pass_rule.note: not statistically significant never means credit quality preserved

delinquent_per_1000_randomized.name: early-delinquent loans per 1,000 randomized users
delinquent_per_1000_randomized.label: inconclusive
delinquent_per_1000_randomized.margin_rationale: At the 3pp business MDE, the simpler flow adds about 13.9 disbursed loans per 1,000 randomized users. Each early-delinquent loan forgoes the profit of a good loan and loses about 45% of principal, so the extra loans stay profitable only while no more than 15.1% of them go early-delinquent. The margin is that break-even count. Note the per-user count rises mechanically with conversion: more loans means more delinquent loans even at an unchanged per-loan rate.

early_delinquency_rate.name: early delinquency rate among disbursed loans
early_delinquency_rate.label: pass
early_delinquency_rate.margin_rationale: Roughly a quarter of the ~6% baseline; beyond this the credit policy team would re-price. Diagnostic only: the treatment changes who gets a loan, so arms hold different borrower mixes.

approval_rate.name: approval rate among credit decisions
approval_rate.label: pass
approval_rate.margin_rationale: A drop beyond 3pp would signal the simplified flow is filling the decision queue with applicants underwriting rejects, raising bureau and ops cost per loan. Diagnostic only.

per_loan_vs_per_user.explanation: Per loan, the early delinquency rate moved from 6.76% to 6.72% (-0.04pp). Per 1,000 randomized users, early-delinquent loans moved from 15.51 to 16.93 (+1.42). The per-user count rises mechanically with conversion: the treatment arm disbursed 251.9 loans per 1,000 randomized users vs 229.5 in control, so it carries more delinquent loans even at an unchanged per-loan rate. The per-loan rate compares different borrower mixes, because the simpler flow lets marginal applicants through, so only the per-user count is a randomized comparison, and only it decides.

outcome_maturity_note: Early delinquency covers only the first EMI (30+ days past due). Later delinquency and eventual losses are not yet observable for these loans.
